headline: Grumpy Walrus received one inbound transfer at 1:31 PM ET (~57.2 ADA plus ~98 NIGHT, ~1.29k MEPE and dust ASCEND/STRIKE/iBTC/Guinea Pig, ~80 ADA total); not a buy; net ADA ~+57; no swaps since noon. New swarm launches DESSA, GEORGE and MEPA (coordinated buyers, repeat early buyers, MEPA pool pre-seeder) are Pass and SW-01 pending_gate; GG and MIXI failed the SW-01 gate (no DEX pool at 24h). ASCEND side ~1.068M (~42.5% above line), COCK ~134.2k (10.5% under). Nothing passes k/y; no SW-01 ticket.
learned: Lessons: an inbound transfer of ADA plus leftover token dust can show up as a "new position" whale_move; it is not a buy, so check the tx shape before reading it as accumulation.
